description: Create high-quality, SEO-optimized content that ranks AND reads like a human wrote it. Performs live SERP gap analysis, writes with anti-AI detection techniques, and adds schema markup. For a single alternatives or vs/comparison page, see /competitor-alternatives; for a multi-phase page roadmap with a persistent tracker, see /seo-machine.
